cards.title: AI-driven kanban card creation
cards.description: The AI agent should be the primary way users add cards to the kanban board — capture tasks from conversation and add them automatically.

cards.title: Make agent-directed searches
cards.description: Let the agent harness drive workspace search — query the renderer's search index or filesystem from agent prompts, parse results, and navigate to matching diagrams/code. Currently search is manual-only.

cards.title: Identify the second status indicator on the agent screen
cards.description: The agent screen (ChatPanel) shows a green dot saying READY (StatusBadge). There's a second colored ball nearby that isn't labeled — need to figure out what it represents. Candidates: the run-chip status-dot from ScriptControls (App.tsx:174) or the room-chat status dot. Once identified, either label it or remove it if redundant.

cards.title: Add agent-controllable browser view
cards.description: A global toolbar icon that opens an in-app browser panel (like Codex's browser). The agent should be able to drive it — navigate, inspect, screenshot — so we can test the browser apps codeswim generates. Lives as a side panel or overlay, not an external window.

cards.title: Create new files and folders in package explorer
cards.description: Add the ability to create new files and folders directly from the package explorer tree view — right-click or add-button context menu with inline naming.

cards.title: Move 'Open in editor' from header to file viewer
cards.description: The open-in-editor button shouldn't be in the app header; it should be a button in the viewer for the file.

cards.title: Node deep-linking to specific code sections
cards.description: When clicking a node related to specific code, navigate to that exact section (e.g. `# enemy-detection` anchor) rather than just the file.

cards.title: Fix refresh bug — files show 'loading' forever
cards.description: When clicking refresh, files show 'loading' state indefinitely until clicked individually.

cards.title: Fix skill load/link buttons at workspace level
cards.description: The skill load and link buttons don't work at the workspace level.

cards.title: Add internal browser (like Codex)
cards.description: The agent should have an internal browser it can view and control to help debug and improve the app.

cards.title: Auto-create GitHub kanban board project
cards.description: Codeswim should automatically create a kanban board project on GitHub for the repo.

cards.title: Show Agent.md in skills menu
cards.description: Agent.md should be viewable from the skills menu in the app.

cards.title: Migrate from system.txt to Agent.md
cards.description: Stop using system.txt and use Agent.md instead. Needs discussion before updating.

cards.title: Team chat feature per GitHub repo
cards.description: Add ability to chat with teammates based on GitHub URL. Repo owner defines chat structure, admins, bans via a file. Requires a websocket server.

cards.title: In-app kanban board for project tracking
cards.description: Add a kanban board view for tracking project progress within codeswim.

cards.title: Add disable button for skills
cards.description: Add a toggle/button to disable a skill without deleting it, so the agent stops loading it as a tool. Currently skills can only be deleted or left as read-only. A disabled state would let users temporarily turn off skills they don't need for a given session.

cards.title: Drag files into package explorer view
cards.description: Support dragging files from the filesystem into the package explorer tree to add them to the project, with automatic placement in the correct folder.

cards.title: Surface every UI action through agent-controllable tools
cards.description: Audit all interactive UI surfaces (file tree, search, git panel, kanban, skills, settings, terminal, MCP tools, pull requests) and expose them as agent-callable tools or programmatic APIs so the agent can drive the full app without requiring manual clicks. Goal: the agent is a first-class user of every feature, not just the diagram editor.

cards.title: Make git diffs readable for non-expert users
cards.description: The raw unified diff format (index line, ---/+++, @@ hunk headers) is confusing. Replace or augment the diff view with something more approachable — side-by-side rendering, syntax-highlighted lines, or a collapsed summary of changes per file. The DiffView.tsx component is where this lives.

cards.title: Add light/dark mode toggle
cards.description: The app should support both light mode and dark mode themes.

cards.title: More skills information
cards.description: Show how many times a skill has been invoked.

cards.title: Add play button to execute Ready items
cards.description: A play/execute button on the Ready column (or in the header) that runs all cards currently in the Ready column — e.g. spawning the agent to process them sequentially, or kicking off the scripts/flows they represent. Should show progress and aggregate results.
